caption: In this invented example, clone B grows from 2/6 collected T cells to 8/12 cultured T cells while A and C each remain two cells. No elapsed culture time is specified; tumor origin is not specificity and yield is not potency. Whole-regimen evidence cannot be attributed to the cells alone.
alt: An invented tumor-tissue snapshot contains six T cells: two each from native clones A, B and C. After culture, twelve cells include two A, eight virus-reactive bystander B and two unknown C. Each lettered cell is one counted cell; changed mixture and yield do not prove potency. A complete treatment regimen includes more than these cells.
